title.zh: 阿联酋牵头30国反诈行动：识别超390亿美元涉诈资金，逮捕逾960人
title.en: 阿联酋牵头30国反诈行动：识别超390亿美元涉诈资金，逮捕逾960人

current_state.zh: The UAE announced results of the 30-country 'Confrontation Ghost' operation (July 1–Sept 30), which identified over $39 billion in fraud-related funds including crypto, arrested more than 960 suspects, raided 29 scam centers and flagged 4,100+ fraudulent bank accounts.
current_state.en: The UAE announced results of the 30-country 'Confrontation Ghost' operation (July 1–Sept 30), which identified over $39 billion in fraud-related funds including crypto, arrested more than 960 suspects, raided 29 scam centers and flagged 4,100+ fraudulent bank accounts.
